name: Wanshi Zhenshui (萬世珍水)
verdict: Wanshi Zhenshui is the core brand of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor, a state-owned liquor company controlled (51%) by Chengdu Industrial Investment Group; announced by Chengdu Rongcheng FC on 18 May 2026 as a 2026-season strategic partner whose brand is to appear on the first-team shirt chest.
aliases: 成都蓉酒酒业有限公司

why.text: Wanshi Zhenshui is the core brand of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor, whose five state-owned shareholders are led by Chengdu Industrial Investment Group with a controlling 51%, and whose actual controller is the Chengdu municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Wanshi Zhenshui is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China's large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Rating note: proposed 'serious' — the Chinese state controls the sponsor (the link, claims chengdu-rongjiu-industrial-group-ownership + chengdu-rongjiu-sasac-actual-controller: a controlling 51% state stake and the Chengdu Municipal SASAC as actual controller; METHOD.md counts control), and the record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment) is documented for that state. ON HOLD: awaits a maintainer's review (tier set by maintainers). Shirt placement: the club's 18 May 2026 announcement says the brand will appear on the first-team shirt chest; a 28 June 2026 press report with match photos found the chest advertisement unchanged (成都蓉城/成都建工) through 27 June, so whether and when the brand reached the shirt is not yet documented.
